freeTierSummary.en: Official open platform by Xiaohongshu's HiLab (dots.ai). The dots3-note-prev model is currently free of charge during the free trial (billing resumes only after advance notice on the official site and docs). No published quota or end date. Compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages; authenticate with the api-key request header.
freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 小红书 HiLab 官方开放平台 dots.ai，dots3-note-prev 模型当前免费体验、暂不收费（恢复收费前会在官网及文档提前告知）。官方未公布免费额度与截止时间。兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Anthropic Messages 双协议，认证用 api-key 请求头。
